facts.text: The Trailblazer Tuition Trust covers 100% of tuition and mandatory fees for up to four years for eligible first-time undergraduate Texas residents.

sources.title: Trailblazer Tuition Trust - UNT Dallas
sources.quote: Eligible first-time undergraduate students pursuing their first bachelor's degree at UNT Dallas may have 100% of tuition and mandatory fees covered through a combination of federal, state and institutional grants and scholarships for up to four years (eight consecutive semesters).
